simple.meaning: צָנַף (tsânaph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to wrap , i.e. roll or dress.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Leviticus, Isaiah, beginning at Leviticus 16:4. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָנַף (H6801).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H6801. tsanaph [ צָנַף ] verb wrap, or wind up, together (compare Arabic hem of garment, ᵑ7 J צְנָפָא skirt ( = כָּנָף ); מַצְנֵפָא turban , Christian-Palestinian Aramaic tassel ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִצְנֹף Lev 16:4 he shall wind (his head) with ( ב ) the turban ( מִצְנֶפֶת q. v.); suffix, + Infinitive absolute and accusative of congnate meaning with verb צְנֵפָה יִצְנָפְךָ צָנוֺף Isa 22:18 he will wind thee entirely up (with) a winding (under figure of ball, to be driven far off, in exile). — צנוף 62:3 see following.
